title: RIFLEx: A Free Lunch for Length Extrapolation in Video Diffusion Transformers
source_version: PMLR volume 267 published original; retrieved exact supplied PDF URL
summary: Reported method has empirical support, but component-period arithmetic does not guarantee content non-repetition; released 0.9 frequency factor differs from Algorithm 1 and metric/quality claims need qualification.
limitations: Static figures viewed, no video playback or author code/model execution.
Private training set, complete evaluation prompts/raw scores, metric implementation and multi-GPU branch not acquired.
Separate OpenReview attachments unavailable; bibliography and later revisions not audited.

problems.judgment: General content non-repetition inference invalid; empirical heuristic remains plausible
problems.evidence: At Hunyuan k4 period, k5 phase=-1; full embedding need not repeat, and content-dependent Q/K/V are not fixed. Single-cycle code can have nearly coincident endpoints.
problems.counterevidence: Authors explicitly defer theoretical foundation; observed ablations and NTK period arithmetic support setting-specific heuristic.
problems.repair: State empirical scope; use full rotary-pair difference norm and controlled interventions; do not present Eq8 as sufficient content guarantee.
problems.core_dependency: Mechanistic interpretation, not a disproved empirical implementation.

independent_check.alternatives_and_scope: Component influence is a plausible learned heuristic and authors explicitly call identification empirical. No assertion about unseen playback or algorithmic failure.
independent_check.result: Supported Minor mechanistic overclaim; retain empirical benefit and the matched NTK setting-specific arithmetic.
